en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a historic European spa town nestled in a narrow forested valley. Dense wooded hills rise on both sides, enclosing a tightly packed ensemble of multi‑storey townhouses and grand hotels along a curving valley floor and river. Several ornate buildings with towers and spires line the central axis, with narrow streets and terraced structures climbing the slopes. The overall look is early‑20th‑century Central European architecture. No printed text or caption is visible on the card front.
